shortDescription: Configure Local certificate group on FortiADC devices via RESTful APIs

options.name: OCSP_stapling
options.description: Select an OCSP Stapling configuration. The local certificate in the OCSP Stapling configuration must match the local certificate in the local certificate group member.

options.name: action
options.description: Type of action to perform on the object

options.name: default
options.description: Enable if you want to make this local certificate the default for the group.

options.name: extra_local_cert
options.description: FortiADC supports dual SSL certificates, one for an RSA-based SSL certificate and the other for an ECDSA-based SSL certificate. This option allows you to add an additional local certificate along with an additional OCSP stapling and intermediate CA group to a local certificate group configuration.

options.name: intermediate_cag
options.description: Select an intermediate CA group to add to the local group.

options.name: local_cert
options.description: Select a local certificate to add to the group.
